label: Fillet
help: Click edges of a body in the viewport; clicking again removes an edge. Choose the type and size. Radius from scan fits a cylinder to the scan triangles along the edges and takes the snapped radius. The edges are kept when earlier steps change.

notices.otherBody: All edges must belong to one body. Remove the edges first to use another body.
notices.ownEdge: This edge only exists because of this fillet.
notices.notOnBody: This body is created after this step.

measuring: Measuring the radius on the scan …
tooFewFaces: Radius from scan not possible: too few scan triangles at the edges ({{count}}, at least {{min}}). Zoom closer to the edges.
